translations.web: Behold, this is the joy of his way: out of the earth, others will spring.
translations.bsb: Surely this is the joy of his way; yet others will spring from the dust.
translations.kjv: Behold, this is the joy of his way, and out of the earth shall others grow.
translations.asv: Behold, this is the joy of his way; And out of the earth shall others spring.
